newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto started with buy.

text.p: - Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg initiated coverage of Monsanto Co with a buy rating.

- Monsanto is becoming less dependent on chemicals and more dependent on agricultural biotech and pharmaceuticals, she said in a report. The company has launched its first biotech product and successfully introduced Ambien, a sleeping pill, she noted.
- In addition, significant markets are being created for the company's Roundup herbicide, which generates about 50 percent of Monsanto's annual operating profits, she said.
- Monsanto is expected to generate $1.5 billion in operating cash flow in 1996 and $1.7 billion in 1997, which will allow the company to pursue ventures, she said.
- Wittenberg estimates Monsanto's earnings per share growth at 18-20 percent for the next three to four years.
- Monsanto shares are currently trading up 1/2 to 34-1/4.
